paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless), as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper sets 95% credible upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mX from Juno MAG data of the Jovian magnetic field. Explicit text values: at eps=1, exclusion spans 3.2e-18 eV <= mX <= 3.2e-14 eV; strongest bound eps <= 2.8e-3 at mX = 2.0e-15 eV. Full exclusion contour is in Fig. 7 but only these three anchor points are given numerically in text, so the curve shape between anchors is approximate. Limit is independent of dark photon relic density (not a DM haloscope), hence no local DM density assumption. Paper also sets a photon mass bound m_gamma < 2.5e-18 eV, which is not encoded here since it is not a coupling-type limit in the enum. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 37)) | Vision: Traced the red 'Juno MAG (This Work)' 95% credible limit in Fig. 7 (image fig_06.png). This constraint is independent of the dark photon relic density (dark photon need not be dark matter). The green shaded region (m_X >= 1.8e-15 eV) is the COBE/FIRAS bound, not traced here.
